# Dayopt

> Dayopt is a timeboxing app for individuals. It combines planning, time tracking, tasks, and calendar in one place. You plan your day with time blocks, record what actually happened, and see the patterns.

Dayopt shows what actually happened with your time, not just what you planned.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://dayopt.app/docs): How to use Dayopt. Start here.
- [Plans](https://dayopt.app/docs/plans): Create time blocks for your day.
- [Records](https://dayopt.app/docs/records): Track what actually happened.
